definitions.explanation: Money spent on alcoholic drinks, especially at a bar, izakaya, or drinking party.

examples.english: To treat someone to the drinks.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}の{飲|の}み{代|だい}は{割|わ}り{勘|かん}にしよう。
{給料日|きゅうりょうび}の{前|まえ}は{飲|の}み{代|だい}を{節約|せつやく}している。
examples.english: Before payday I cut back on my drinking expenses.

notes:
Formed from {飲|の}む (to drink) plus {代|だい} (charge, fee). A colloquial word for the money spent on alcohol, distinct from the cost of food.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}をおごる: to treat someone to the drinks
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}を{割|わ}り{勘|かん}にする: to split the drinking bill
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}がかさむ: for the drinking tab to add up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲食代|いんしょくだい}: food and drink bill — covers meals as well as drinks
- ツケ: tab; deferred payment — an unpaid running account, not the amount itself
